risks.cause: Official Discord documentation does not publish refresh token rotation policy (single-use vs multi-use). If single-use rotation is enforced, concurrent refresh calls without locking will trigger 400 invalid_grant.

risks.mitigation: Deploy distributed refresh token mutex lock as a generic safety precaution and log token response headers comprehensively.

sections.title: 1. Integration Overview
sections.summary: Architectural blueprint and integration readiness profile for Discord.
sections.contentMarkdown: This implementation guide provides verified engineering specifications for integrating with Discord. The design follows the evidence-backed findings extracted from the official developer documentation (https://discord.com/developers/docs/topics/oauth2).

technicalInstructions.instruction: Target authentication method: OAuth 2.0 PKCE.
Architecture enforces strict separation of public client authorization and backend secret storage.

sections.title: 2. Prerequisites & Credentials
sections.summary: Required developer credentials, administrative privileges, and infrastructure.
sections.contentMarkdown: Before writing code, verify that your engineering team possesses the necessary administrative and developer assets for Discord.

technicalInstructions.instruction: Obtain a verified developer account on the official Discord Developer Portal.
Ensure HTTPS endpoint infrastructure is available for staging and production OAuth callback handling.

sections.title: 3. Provider Application Registration
sections.summary: Registering the OAuth application and securing client identifiers.
sections.contentMarkdown: Navigate to the Discord Developer Console and register a new application.

technicalInstructions.instruction: Create the application record: Discord Developer Portal application registration.
Store the issued Client ID and Client Secret in an environment secrets manager (e.g. AWS Secrets Manager or GCP Secret Manager). Never commit secrets to source repositories.

sections.title: 4. OAuth 2.0 Configuration
sections.summary: Grant type selection, PKCE parameter requirement, and client configuration.
sections.contentMarkdown: Configure the OAuth 2.0 exchange mechanisms based on documented provider capabilities.

technicalInstructions.instruction: Officially recommended grant: Authorization Code Grant with PKCE. Discord officially recommends using the Authorization Code Grant with Proof Key for Code Exchange (PKCE) for production applications.
technicalInstructions.evidenceText: For production apps, use the authorization code grant with PKCE instead.

technicalInstructions.instruction: Do NOT use the Implicit Grant: Discord warns against using the implicit grant in production environments due to token leakage risks and lack of refresh tokens.
technicalInstructions.evidenceText: The implicit grant is not recommended outside of quick prototypes. It returns the access token directly in the redirect URL, where it can leak through browser history, logs, and Referer headers, and it doesn’t provide a refresh token.

codeSnippet.caption: PKCE S256 Code Challenge Generation (RFC 7636)

sections.title: 5. Redirect URI Setup
sections.summary: Registering exact HTTPS redirect endpoints and preventing open redirection.
sections.contentMarkdown: Discord enforces strict redirect URI matching. Every redirect URI must be explicitly registered prior to initiating authorization requests.

technicalInstructions.instruction: Configured redirect policy: Strict HTTPS redirect URI matching; localhost permitted for development.
Ensure the callback URI does not contain wildcards, fragment identifiers (#), or HTTP schemes in production.

sections.title: 6. Scope Selection & Justifications
sections.summary: Selecting minimal necessary permission strings and managing scope tiers.
sections.contentMarkdown: Request only the scopes required for your application's active features. Excess scopes increase user abandonment and may trigger mandatory compliance reviews.

technicalInstructions.instruction: Scope 'identify' [Standard]: Allows /users/@me without email. Audit requirement: Self-service user consent
Scope 'email' [Standard]: Enables /users/@me with email. Audit requirement: User consent prompt
Scope 'guilds' [Standard]: Allows /users/@me/guilds. Audit requirement: User consent prompt

sections.title: 7. Authentication Flow Walkthrough
sections.summary: Assembling the authorization URL, user consent handoff, and code exchange.
sections.contentMarkdown: The authorization workflow begins when a user initiates the integration handoff in your application.

technicalInstructions.instruction: Generate a cryptographically secure random `state` parameter and persist it in a session cookie.
Redirect user to provider authorization endpoint with client_id, redirect_uri, response_type=code, scope, state, and code_challenge.
Upon callback, verify `state` matches session cookie before submitting code exchange POST request.

codeSnippet.caption: Token Exchange Request Structure

sections.title: 8. Token Management & Rotation
sections.summary: Access token expiration handling, refresh token safety, and storage security.
sections.contentMarkdown: Handle issued credentials according to documented token lifespan and rotation semantics.

technicalInstructions.instruction: Access tokens issued via the OAuth 2.0 authorization code exchange return an expires_in lifespan of 604,800 seconds (7 days). (Applicability: OAuth 2.0 Bearer access tokens returned via Authorization Code Grant exchange)
GENERIC ENGINEERING RECOMMENDATION: In high-concurrency environments, implement a mutex lock around refresh requests to prevent race conditions in case single-use rotation is enforced.

PROVIDER REFRESH ROTATION BEHAVIOR UNKNOWN: Discord developer documentation does not publish whether refresh tokens are single-use or reusable. Do not assume single-use rotation is enforced until verified.

warnings: Applies strictly to user-authorized access tokens; bot tokens do not expire on this schedule.

sections.title: 9. Resource Access Validation
sections.summary: Resource-level authorization checks and workspace sharing models.
sections.contentMarkdown: Respect the boundary between ambient account authorization and specific resource access.

technicalInstructions.instruction: Workspace sharing model: Guild owner or administrator installs integration..
Catch HTTP 403 Forbidden responses specifically indicating that the authorized user lacks access to the requested target document/channel.

sections.title: 10. Error Handling & Rate Limit Backoff
sections.summary: Handling OAuth errors, rate limit quotas, and transient network failures.
sections.contentMarkdown: Implement robust error handling for standard OAuth 2.0 error codes and rate limit headers.

technicalInstructions.instruction: Discord enforces an isolated, dedicated set of rate limits specifically for bot tokens. (Applicability: Bot user tokens and bot-authorized API requests)
technicalInstructions.evidenceText: Bots have an entirely separate set of rate limits .

technicalInstructions.instruction: On HTTP 429, parse the `Retry-After` response header and queue requests with jittered exponential backoff.

sections.title: 11. Security Considerations
sections.summary: CSRF defense, secret leakage prevention, and secure token storage.
sections.contentMarkdown: Security safeguards are mandatory to protect user tokens from interception or leakage.

technicalInstructions.instruction: Encrypt access and refresh tokens at rest in database using AES-256-GCM.
Never return access tokens or refresh tokens to client-side browsers or single-page applications.

sections.title: 12. Testing Checklist
sections.summary: Pre-production test scenarios covering happy path, revocation, and failure states.
sections.contentMarkdown: Execute these automated and manual verification tests in a staging environment prior to production deployment.

technicalInstructions.instruction: Test 1: User initiates authorization and grants consent -> code exchanged -> tokens persisted.
Test 2: Tampered state parameter is rejected with HTTP 400 Bad Request.
Test 3: Token expiration simulated -> refresh token exchanged -> new access token stored.
Test 4: User revokes connection in provider portal -> application handles 401 and prompts reconnect.

sections.title: 13. Production Deployment Checklist
sections.summary: Operational verification for launch, telemetry, and secret rotation.
sections.contentMarkdown: Verify all operational readiness items before enabling integration in production.

technicalInstructions.instruction: Production client credentials provisioned and injected into production vault.
Production redirect URIs registered and verified in provider developer portal.
Monitoring alerts configured for 401 Unauthorized spikes (>5% in 5m) and 429 Throttling events.

sections.title: 14. Known Limitations & Unresolved Questions
sections.summary: Unpublished documentation areas, known constraints, and provider-specific nuances.
sections.contentMarkdown: The following items represent areas where the investigated documentation was silent or where engineering limitations exist.

technicalInstructions.instruction: Documented limitation: Detailed code_challenge schema parameters are not published on the primary topic page.
Documented limitation: Global user-token rate limits require consulting the dedicated rate limits documentation.
